item.tib: rig 'dzin gsang ba'i sgrub pa sku gsum dgongs pa 'dus pa las dam sri glud rdzongs kyi le'u
item.coloph: bdag 'dra bde chen gling pa rtsal gyis rkong (kong) rong dbus phug gsang ba yang rdzong nas spyan drangs te slar drag po g.yu mtsho mdangs ldan gling du shog ser bod yig tu bshus pa dge'o
